people.name: Yahya ibn Muhammad Hamid al-Din
people.nameZh: 葉海亞·穆罕默德·哈米德丁

body.zh-Hant: 依土耳其學者穆斯塔法·博斯坦奇（Mustafa Bostancı）的論文，葉海亞（Yahya b. Muhammed Hamîdiddîn）於伊斯蘭曆1286年（1869年）生於薩那。伊瑪目哈米丁（Hamidüddin）去世後，他於1904年6月5日在卡夫萊特阿濟爾（Kafletüazir）以「穆塔瓦基勒·阿拉安拉」（Mütevekkil-Alellah）稱號就任伊瑪目。1904年底他起兵反抗奧斯曼，1905年4月攻佔薩那及其周邊。
body.en: According to the study by the Turkish scholar Mustafa Bostancı, Yahya b. Muhammed Hamîdiddîn was born in Sanaa in AH 1286 (1869). After the death of Imam Hamidüddin he took up the imamate on 5 June 1904 at Kafletüazir with the title al-Mutawakkil ʿalā Allāh. At the end of 1904 he rose against the Ottomans, and in April 1905 he took Sanaa and its surroundings.

İmam Hamidüddin’in ölümü üzerine
20 Rebîülevvel 1322’de (5 Haziran 1904)
Kafletüazir’de “Mütevekkil-Alellah” unvanıyla imâmet görevini üstlenmiştir
1904 yılı sonlarında Osmanlı Devleti’ne karşı isyan başlatmıştır
1905 Nisanında San’a ve çevresini ele geçirmiştir

heading.en: The Treaty of Daan and independent rule

body.zh-Hant: 1911年10月9日雙方簽訂《達安（Daân）條約》，葉海亞因此取得管理宗教基金、任命栽德派法官等權利。他遵守條約，一戰中與奧斯曼人並肩為葉門作戰。奧斯曼軍隊依《穆德羅斯停戰協定》撤出阿拉伯半島後，他成為獨立葉門的統治者，1920年起栽德派伊瑪目國被稱為「葉門穆塔瓦基勒王國」；《Store norske leksikon》也寫道，奧斯曼軍隊於一戰後撤出，栽德派伊瑪目葉海亞掌控了全國。
body.en: On 9 October 1911 the Treaty of Daan was signed, and Yahya gained rights such as the administration of pious endowments and the appointment of Zaydi judges. He kept to the treaty and in the First World War fought for Yemen alongside the Ottomans. When Ottoman troops left the Arabian Peninsula under the Armistice of Mudros he became the ruler of an independent Yemen, and from 1920 the Zaydi imamate was called the Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen; Store norske leksikon likewise says that after the Ottoman withdrawal following the First World War the Zaydi imam Yahya secured control of the country.

heading.zh-Hant: 擴張、與義大利往來及沙葉戰爭
heading.en: Expansion, ties with Italy and the Saudi-Yemeni war

body.zh-Hant: 1925年葉海亞攻佔荷臺達（Hudeyde）；1926年他與義大利簽訂為期十年的友好貿易條約，藉此取得義大利的武器與技術援助。葉門軍隊佔領奈季蘭（Najran）；兩國代表團在薩那會面，首次會議於1933年7月10日舉行。1934年沙烏地阿拉伯與葉門發生短暫的邊界戰爭，沙烏地方獲勝；雙方全權代表於5月19日簽署《塔伊夫條約》，葉海亞於1934年6月26日在薩那批准。《Store norske leksikon》另記，伊瑪目於1934年接受了英國與土耳其之間劃定的邊界。
body.en: In 1925 Yahya took Hudeyde; in 1926 he concluded a ten-year friendship and trade treaty with Italy and obtained Italian arms and technical aid. Yemeni forces occupied Najran; the two delegations met in Sanaa, and the first session was held on 10 July 1933. In 1934 a short border war between Saudi Arabia and Yemen ended in a Saudi victory; the plenipotentiaries signed the Treaty of Taif on 19 May, and Yahya ratified it in Sanaa on 26 June 1934. Store norske leksikon adds that the imam accepted in 1934 the border drawn between the British and the Turks.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰中立、美國承認與1948年遇害
heading.en: Wartime neutrality, US recognition and the 1948 killing

body.zh-Hant: 《Store norske leksikon》指出，葉海亞與法西斯義大利早有往來，但二戰期間保持中立。1946年3月4日，美國總統杜魯門致函「葉門國王」伊瑪目葉海亞，承認葉門王國為主權國家；美國與葉門並同意派遣美國特別外交使團，由威廉·埃迪出任團長。1948年葉海亞在一場政變中遇害，其子艾哈邁德接掌政權。
body.en: Store norske leksikon notes that Yahya had an established relationship with Fascist Italy but stayed neutral in the Second World War. On 4 March 1946 President Truman, in a letter to the Imam Yahya, the King of the Yemen, recognised the Kingdom of the Yemen as a sovereign state; the United States and Yemen also agreed to an American Special Diplomatic Mission headed by William A. Eddy. In 1948 Yahya was killed in a coup and his son Ahmad took power.

people.name: ʿAbd al-ʿAziz ibn ʿAbd al-Rahman Al Saʿud (Ibn Saud)
people.nameZh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齊茲·伊本·紹德

heading.en: Background and the recovery of Najd

body.zh-Hant: 挪威《Store norske leksikon》條目稱，阿卜杜勒-阿齊茲·本·阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼·阿勒沙特（西方稱伊本·紹德）是沙烏地阿拉伯國的建立者與首任國王；條目載其生於1875年9月23日，但註明生年不確定，另有來源作1880年。沙特家族於1891年被逐往科威特流亡；1901年伊本·紹德自科威特出發，設法奪回故地，到1902年已掌控內志（Najd）。
body.en: The Store norske leksikon entry says that Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud, known in the West as Ibn Saud, founded the state of Saudi Arabia and was its first king; it gives his birth as 23 September 1875 but notes that the year is uncertain and that some sources give 1880. The Saud family was driven into exile in Kuwait in 1891; in 1901 Ibn Saud left Kuwait to try to win the territory back, and by 1902 he had secured control of Najd.

Usikkert fødselsår. Noen kilder oppgir 1880.

heading.zh-Hant: 與英國的協議與取得漢志
heading.en: The agreement with Britain and the conquest of Hejaz

body.zh-Hant: 1915年12月26日，伊本·紹德與英國簽訂協議，英國承認內志的獨立地位。一戰後他向漢志推進：沙烏地軍隊1924年攻下麥加、1925年攻下吉達，其中1925年12月24日進入吉達；1926年1月7日漢志民眾向他宣誓效忠，他因此得「漢志之王暨內志蘇丹」的稱號。1927年5月20日他與英國簽訂《吉達條約》，英國藉此確認他的完全獨立。
body.en: On 26 December 1915 Ibn Saud concluded an agreement with Britain, and Britain recognised the independence of Najd. After the First World War he pressed into Hejaz: Saudi forces took Mecca in 1924 and Jeddah in 1925, entering Jeddah on 24 December 1925; on 7 January 1926 the people of Hejaz swore allegiance to him, and he took the title King of Hejaz and Sultan of Najd. On 20 May 1927 he signed the Treaty of Jeddah with Britain, by which Britain confirmed his full independence.

heading.zh-Hant: 沙烏地阿拉伯王國的成立
heading.en: Founding of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

body.zh-Hant: 1931年5月1日，美國承認「漢志與內志王國及其屬地」。依1932年9月18日的敕令，國名改為沙烏地阿拉伯王國；王國的宣告並於9月22日通告英國。《Store norske leksikon》的另一條目則寫，漢志與內志的雙重王國連同哈薩與阿西爾，於1932年9月23日成為獨立的沙烏地阿拉伯王國。
body.en: On 1 May 1931 the United States recognised the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd and its Dependencies. By a decree of 18 September 1932 the name of the state was changed to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the proclamation of the kingdom was notified to Britain on 22 September. A Store norske leksikon article instead says that the double kingdom, together with Hasa and Asir, became the independent Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on 23 September 1932.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿西爾、對葉門的戰爭與石油特許
heading.en: Asir, the war with Yemen and the oil concession

body.zh-Hant: 1933年沙烏地阿拉伯把第一份石油勘探特許權給了加州標準石油公司，即後來的阿美公司。《Store norske leksikon》記載他在1933至1934年征服阿西爾；1934年沙葉兩國發生短暫的邊界戰爭，沙烏地方獲勝。1934年5月19日雙方全權代表簽署《塔伊夫條約》，阿卜杜勒-阿齊茲於6月12日在麥加批准。
body.en: In 1933 Saudi Arabia granted the first oil exploration concession to Standard Oil of California, later Aramco. Store norske leksikon records that he conquered Asir in 1933-1934; in 1934 a short border war between Saudi Arabia and Yemen ended in a Saudi victory. The two plenipotentiaries signed the Treaty of Taif on 19 May 1934, and Abdulaziz ratified it in Mecca on 12 June.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰中立、與美國往來與晚年
heading.en: Wartime neutrality, ties with the United States and later years

body.zh-Hant: 《Store norske leksikon》載，沙烏地阿拉伯在1938年開始商業開採石油。1940年2月4日，美國公使伯特·菲什遞交國書，兩國建立外交關係。二戰期間沙烏地阿拉伯官方保持中立，實際上傾向同盟國；1945年2月14日，阿卜杜勒-阿齊茲在美國軍艦昆西號上會見羅斯福總統。1953年11月9日他逝世，兒子紹德繼位。
body.en: Store norske leksikon says commercial oil extraction began in 1938. Diplomatic relations with the United States were established on 4 February 1940 when Bert Fish presented his credentials. During the Second World War Saudi Arabia was officially neutral but in practice leaned towards the Allies; on 14 February 1945 Abdulaziz met President Roosevelt aboard the US warship Quincy. He died on 9 November 1953 and his son Saud succeeded him.

heading.en: Origins, studies and entry into politics

body.zh-Hant: 勒布倫1871年8月29日生於默爾特-摩澤爾省的梅西勒歐（Mercy-le-Haut），出身農家，是巴黎綜合理工學院與礦業學院的第一名畢業生，先在礦業工程師團任職於維蘇爾，再轉南錫。他進入省議會（Conseil général）的年份，參議院傳記作1892年，愛麗舍宮年表作1898年，兩者不一致；他代表奧迪翁勒羅曼（Audun-le-Romain）選區。1900年阿爾弗雷德·梅濟耶爾（Alfred Mézières）轉任參議員，勒布倫以「左派共和黨人」名義競選布里埃（Briey）選區空出的席位當選；國民議會資料載其首個眾議員任期自1900年12月23日起。
body.en: Lebrun was born on 29 August 1871 at Mercy-le-Haut (Meurthe-et-Moselle) into a farming family and graduated first from both the École polytechnique and the École des mines, then served as a mining engineer at Vesoul and Nancy. The Senate biography dates his entry into the departmental council (Conseil général) to 1892 and the Élysée chronology to 1898; the two sources disagree; he represented the canton of Audun-le-Romain. In 1900 Alfred Mézières left the Chamber for the Senate, and Lebrun stood for the vacant Briey seat under the label of 'républicain de gauche' and won; the National Assembly record gives his first deputy mandate as starting on 23 December 1900.

heading.zh-Hant: 眾議員生涯與部長職務

body.zh-Hant: 1903年勒布倫出任眾議院秘書，1913年當選副議長，1917年主持預算委員會。1911年6月27日至1913年1月12日他任殖民地部長；1月12日至21日在米勒蘭辭職後接掌陸軍（戰爭）部；1913年12月9日至1914年6月9日再任殖民地部長。戰爭爆發後他以砲兵營長身分動員入伍。1917年克里蒙梭擔任總理，堅持要他接任封鎖部，之後轉任解放區部，任期自1917年11月23日至1919年11月6日。
body.en: In 1903 Lebrun became a secretary of the Chamber of Deputies, in 1913 its vice-president, and in 1917 he chaired the budget commission. He was Minister of the Colonies from 27 June 1911 to 12 January 1913, took the War portfolio from 12 to 21 January 1913 after Millerand's resignation, and was again Minister of the Colonies from 9 December 1913 to 9 June 1914. At the outbreak of war he was mobilised as an artillery squadron commander. When Clemenceau became premier in 1917 he insisted that Lebrun accept the Blockade ministry, then the ministry of the Liberated Regions, a post held from 23 November 1917 to 6 November 1919.

heading.en: Senator and President of the Senate

body.zh-Hant: 1920年1月11日勒布倫進入參議院，代表默爾特-摩澤爾省，1924年1月6日連任，至1932年5月12日辭職。1922至1924年他擔任法國駐國際聯盟代表，1923年任殖民科學院院長。1926年起他任參議院副議長，同年受普恩加萊（Poincaré）延攬主持國債償還基金（Caisse autonome d'amortissement），任職五年。1931年杜梅爾（Doumer）當選總統後，勒布倫接任參議院議長，並於次年無對手連任。
body.en: Lebrun entered the Senate for Meurthe-et-Moselle on 11 January 1920, was re-elected on 6 January 1924, and his mandate ended on 12 May 1932 with his resignation. From 1922 to 1924 he was France's delegate to the League of Nations, and in 1923 he became president of the Académie des sciences coloniales. From 1926 he was vice-president of the Senate, and that year Poincaré called him to head the Caisse autonome d'amortissement, which he kept for five years. When Paul Doumer became President of the Republic in 1931, Lebrun succeeded him in the Senate presidency and was re-elected the following year without an opponent.

body.zh-Hant: 1932年5月10日杜梅爾遇刺後，國民議會在凡爾賽集會，勒布倫於第一輪投票就以777張有效票中的633票當選共和國總統；1939年4月再度連任（愛麗舍宮記為5日，參議院傳記記為6日，兩者不一致）。愛麗舍宮的年表指出，除了1934年召回杜梅格（Doumergue）與1936年挑選布魯姆（Blum）之外，他很少介入政府事務，其任內1932至1940年間更換了17位部長會議主席。1934年2月6日騷亂之後，他召請前總統加斯東·杜梅格組成國民聯合政府。
body.en: After President Doumer's assassination the National Assembly met at Versailles on 10 May 1932, and Lebrun was elected President of the Republic on the first ballot with 633 of 777 votes cast. He was re-elected in April 1939 (the Élysée gives the 5th, the Senate biography the 6th; the two disagree). The Élysée chronology notes that, apart from recalling Gaston Doumergue in 1934 and choosing Léon Blum in 1936, he intervened little in the conduct of government, and there were 17 premiers between 1932 and 1940. After the riot of 6 February 1934 he recalled former president Gaston Doumergue to head a government of national union.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月16日，勒布倫在保羅·雷諾因反對停戰而辭職後，任命貝當為部長會議主席；7月10日他未辭職便把權力交給貝當，前往伊澤爾省的維濟耶（Vizille）。1943年8月27日他被蓋世太保逮捕，押往德國控制下蒂羅爾的伊特爾城堡（Itter）。1944年10月11日戴高樂接見他，1945年4月25日他在貝當與賴伐爾的審判中作證，1950年3月6日於巴黎去世。
body.en: On 16 June 1940, after the resignation of Paul Reynaud, who opposed the armistice, Lebrun named Philippe Pétain president of the council; on 10 July he left power to Pétain without resigning and went to Vizille (Isère). On 27 August 1943 he was arrested by the Gestapo and deported to Germany, to the Itter castle in the Tyrol. On 11 October 1944 he was received by General de Gaulle, on 25 April 1945 he testified at the trials of Pétain and Laval, and he died in Paris on 6 March 1950.
